upload_contract.boundary_rule: Exactly 10485760 bytes and up to 5 selected files are eligible; 10485761 bytes or a sixth file is rejected. Validate extension, media type and safe content consistency before any ready/available state.

Existing approved bundled files with actual bytes may be downloaded truthfully.

entity_state_contract.authority: Canonical fixture schemas and TRANSITIONS_AND_POLICIES.md. Friendly UI labels and derived filters never become new stored states. Runtime extensions below must be explicitly typed/versioned; preserve existing fixture values.

entity_state_contract.invoice_overdue: Derived issued/partially_paid + positive gross balance + sample clock past due; not an invoice.state value.

receipts.observation_state.rule: A usable confirmed sample receipt has observation_state=sample_confirmed. Pending/unknown/failed are request/attempt states, not received money and not a fabricated receipt confirmed enum.

receipts.reconciliation_state.rule: Use review_required while a mismatch, unallocated gross, shortfall issue or other unresolved reconciliation condition remains. Set reconciled only after valid matching satisfies the applicable receipt/reconciliation conditions; fee/net do not determine gross invoice settlement.

No generic toggle to resolved.

work_tasks.state.rule: Use not_started when reopening an ordinary administrative task; a professional task may return from owner_reported_delivered to in_progress only before buyer acceptance. Task state cannot set project buyer acceptance.
